market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $70,000 in May?

assessment.reasoning: BTC ~$79k on May 4 2026, would need ~11.4% drawdown to touch $70k anytime in remaining ~27 days of May. BTC up 17% past month, momentum bullish, but historical 1-month drawdowns of >11% occur in ~25-30% of months. Independent estimate ~20% given current upward trend offsetting baseline volatility.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro/geopolitical shocks could trigger a fast 10%+ pullback
